audit_event_case_needs_practice.name: audit_event_case_needs_practice
audit_event_case_needs_practice.value: "audit_event"."case_id" is null or "audit_event"."practice_id" is not null

audit_event_model_step_complete.name: audit_event_model_step_complete
audit_event_model_step_complete.value:
("audit_event"."model_id" is null and "audit_event"."model_input_sha256" is null and "audit_event"."model_output" is null)
        or ("audit_event"."model_id" is not null and "audit_event"."model_input_sha256" is not null)

estimate_source_photo_complete.name: estimate_source_photo_complete
estimate_source_photo_complete.value:
("estimate_source"."photo" is null) = ("estimate_source"."photo_media_type" is null)
        and ("estimate_source"."photo" is null) = ("estimate_source"."photo_sha256" is null)

estimate_source_photo_size.name: estimate_source_photo_size
estimate_source_photo_size.value: "estimate_source"."photo" is null or octet_length("estimate_source"."photo") between 1 and 5242880

estimate_source_explanation_on_finding.name: estimate_source_explanation_on_finding
estimate_source_explanation_on_finding.value: ("estimate_source"."explanation" is null and "estimate_source"."explanation_fell_back" is null) or "estimate_source"."kind" = 'finding'

estimate_version_totals_when_sent.name: estimate_version_totals_when_sent
estimate_version_totals_when_sent.value:
("estimate_version"."sent_at" is null and "estimate_version"."total_low_pence" is null and "estimate_version"."total_high_pence" is null)
        or ("estimate_version"."sent_at" is not null and "estimate_version"."total_low_pence" is not null and "estimate_version"."total_high_pence" is not null)

hold_authorisation_complete.name: hold_authorisation_complete
hold_authorisation_complete.value:
("hold"."authorization_id" is null) = ("hold"."original_authorization_id" is null)
        and ("hold"."authorization_id" is null) = ("hold"."payment_kind" is null)
        and ("hold"."authorization_id" is null) = ("hold"."authorised_at" is null)

patient_case_vet_name_length.name: patient_case_vet_name_length
patient_case_vet_name_length.value: "patient_case"."vet_name" is null or char_length("patient_case"."vet_name") between 1 and 100

refund_answered_with_id.name: refund_answered_with_id
refund_answered_with_id.value:
("refund"."status" <> 'requested' or "refund"."paypal_refund_id" is null)
        and ("refund"."status" not in ('pending', 'completed') or "refund"."paypal_refund_id" is not null)
